name: Prydwen

attributes.attribute: a magical boat of King Arthur
could sail both this world and the Otherworld
a name also given to Arthur's shield

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Prydwen is a Welsh magical boat said to belong to King Arthur. Some Welsh legends state that it could sail over the waters of this world and of the Otherworld. The name Prydwen also described Arthur's shield at times.

okr.objective: Describe Prydwen as the magical boat and shield name of King Arthur.
key_results: Call it a magical boat of King Arthur.
Note it could sail this world and the Otherworld.
Record the name used for Arthur's shield.
